summary: Cooper signed the SHALOM Act adopting the IHRA antisemitism definition and rejected a legislative effort to block U.S. military aid to Israel in August 2025. His October 7, 2025 post called for ending "death and destruction in Gaza" and peace for those who suffered "in Israel and in Gaza," acknowledging Palestinian harm symmetrically without calling for aid restrictions. DMFI PAC, an electoral committee for Democratic Majority for Israel, spent $2,401 in independent support for his campaign.
